improvement_relation.basis: The response is measured by exact UTF-8 JSON serialization after the fixed-size content digest is added. The regression test forces large owner-pass and Doctor history detail; the live post-push projection uses the same selected session and request budgets as the pre-change overrun.
not_measured: whether any agent was blocked or manually compacted the previous response
agent receipt, time saved, or intervention burden
response-size behavior for all possible evidence windows and limits
longer-term service quality or pressure recurrence

measurement_basis: Implementation, independent automated regression verification, and post-push live response-size readback.

outcome.implementation_change: Added a final summary-only session-activity fallback for oversized ECI responses. It preserves aggregate service coverage, exact source references for recorded owner results, Doctor epoch/history identifiers, and omission markers; it reduces page identity metadata only when needed to meet the requested serialized byte bound.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This verifies response size and retained provenance for the observed workload. It does not establish that agents received the view, spent less time, or experienced better service.
outcome.verified_change: The 161-test capability-intelligence module passes. The same live request now returns 7652 serialized bytes against an 8000-byte limit, retaining two exact Store result links and marking five no-result rows omitted.
